hypotheses.Q1_qk_and_value_factors_recompose_the_so: Query routing, key routing, current values, and persistent-bus values recompose the direct source JVP to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.Q2_query_routing_dominates_the_sharp_pea: Query routing contributes at least 60% of query-plus-key routing norm at the source-derivative peak in both corpora.
hypotheses.Q3_one_native_head_dominates_peak_routin: One head contributes at least 50% of absolute routing norm at the peak in both corpora.
hypotheses.Q4_one_source_edge_dominates_within_the_: One source contributes at least 30% of the dominant head's absolute routing norm at the peak in both corpora.
hypotheses.Q5_the_same_head_recurs_across_corpora: FineWeb and TinyStories have the same dominant layer-1 routing head.
hypotheses.Q6_the_same_source_position_recurs_acros: FineWeb and TinyStories have the same dominant absolute source position within that head.
hypotheses.Q7_persistent_bus_values_dominate_curren: Persistent-bus value derivatives have greater norm than current-value derivatives at the peak in both corpora.
hypotheses.Q8_the_dominant_qk_score_crosses_zero_ne: The dominant head/source raw QK score changes sign on the dense path within 0.10 path distance of the derivative peak.
hypotheses.Q9_query_routing_has_a_large_integrated_: Dense integrated query routing has absolute Fisher projection at least 0.50 in both corpora.
hypotheses.Q10_dense_qkov_factors_recover_the_finit: Their dense sum has at least 0.999 finite Fisher fidelity in both corpora.
